# Introduction #

The two choices for global tempeature are the PAGES2k synthesis, and Mann et al. (2005) gridded (5-deg) reconstructions.

```{r, results="hide"}
# read data
datapath <- "e:/Projects/GPWG/work/feedback/data/sources/"
datafile <- "Mann-and-PAGES2k_tave.csv"
tave <- read.csv(paste(datapath, datafile, sep=""))
attach(tave)
```
```{r}
head(tave); tail(tave)
```

# Basic plots #

```{r}
# plot the two series
xmin <- 500; xmax <- 2020; ymin <- -1.5; ymax <- 2.5; xminortick <- 50
plot(NULL, NULL, type="n", ylab="temperature anomalies", xlim=c(xmin, xmax), ylim=c(ymin, ymax))
lines(YearCE, PAGES2k, col="red")
lines(YearCE, Mann_globe_land, col="blue")
axis(side = 1, at = seq(xmin, xmax, by = xminortick*5), labels = FALSE, tck=1.0, fg="gray70")
axis(side = 1, at = seq(xmin-xminortick, xmax+xminortick, by = xminortick), labels = FALSE, tcl = -.25)
axis(side = 1, at = seq(xmin, xmax, by = xminortick*5), labels = FALSE, tcl = -.5) 
legend("topleft", c("PAGES2k","Mann_globe_land"), lwd=1, col=c("red","blue"))

```
```{r, fig.asp=1, fig.width=5}
plot(NULL, NULL, xlim=c(ymin, ymax), ylim=c(ymin, ymax), xlab="PAGES2k", ylab="Mann_globe_land")
points(PAGES2k, Mann_globe_land, pch=16, cex=0.6, col="gray60")
points(PAGES2k[YearCE < 900], Mann_globe_land[YearCE < 900], pch=16, cex=0.6, col="purple")
points(PAGES2k[YearCE > 2000], Mann_globe_land[YearCE > 2000], pch=16, cex=0.6, col="red")
legend("topleft", c("before 900 CE","after 2000 CE"), pch=16, cex=0.6, col=c("purple","red"))
detach(tave)
```
